title: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.16236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. translated_title: 稀疏协同推理的隐私研究
translated_abstract: 协同推理（CI）将模型在边缘设备与服务器之间拆分，客户端计算中间激活值，传输给服务器，服务器完成剩余计算。这引发了两个问题：传输的通信成本以及传输过程中可能泄露输入隐私信息的风险。近期研究通过稀疏化激活值并对结果进行熵编码来降低通信成本。同时，稀疏性也被认为能提升隐私保护，其直觉依据是传输更少的数值会减少对输入的暴露。我们通过将稀疏激活分解为保留的值及其位置集合，并分别从每个组件重建输入，来验证这一说法。研究发现，稀疏化对隐私泄露的降低程度远低于其对传输成本的降低，且剩余风险转移到了位置信息上，而先前分析通常将位置视为解码的辅助信息。在自然图像上的实验表明，仅从位置信息就能重建出可辨识的输入内容，而保留的值也提供了显著的泄露，尽管其贡献相对较小。因此，稀疏化带来的隐私收益被高估，设计CI系统时需要重新考虑位置信息的安全影响。
tldr: 本文通过分解稀疏激活为值和位置，证明稀疏化降低隐私泄露的效果远弱于降低通信成本的效果，且剩余隐私风险主要转移到位置信息上，挑战了稀疏性提升隐私的假设。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes sparse activations into values and positions to show that sparsification reduces privacy leakage far less than it reduces communication cost, with residual risk shifting to positions, challenging the assumption that sparsity improves privacy.
